summary: The hosts discuss the extremely choppy market conditions across all timeframes, noting that Bitcoin looks poor from the 4-hour through weekly charts. Key BTC levels are 58k support, 61.4-61.7k mid-range, and 64.2k resistance. Duck maintains an underwater ETH spot position with a 2.3k invalidation, while Cred prefers waiting for strength above 2.7-2.8k. They express skepticism about the permanence of the Solana meme coin meta, suggesting liquidity could eventually rotate to a new chain. Sui is highlighted as having the type of chart structure that could attract such rotation.
key_takeaways: Bitcoin is choppy across all timeframes with 58k as critical support and 64.2k as major resistance
ETH needs to reclaim 2.7-2.8k to look attractive; invalidation for current longs is around 2.3k
The Solana meme coin meta may not be permanent - new chain rotation is possible
Sui chart structure resembles what a potential Solana replacement would look like
Current market conditions are poor for day trading - patience for big opportunities is emphasized
